subject: Tool registry contract (S14): register_tool(name, fn, writes, requires_flag), naadi_api/agent/tools/registry.py
body:
# Tutor tool registry contract (S14) — `apps/api/naadi_api/agent/tools/registry.py`

Consumers: S15 (`add_to_knowledge`, `pdf` page in `get_page`), S15b (`generate_image`, `generate_video`).

```python
from naadi_api.agent.tools.registry import register_tool, ToolContext, ToolResult, WriteTool, Proposal

def register_tool(name: str, fn, *, writes: bool, requires_flag: str | None = None) -> None
```
- `name`: snake_case, unique (a second registration of the same name raises at import time).
- Read tool (`writes=False`): `fn` is `async def fn(ctx: ToolContext, args: ArgsModel) -> ToolResult`. `ArgsModel` is a pydantic
  model inferred from the annotation of the second parameter; the docstring's first paragraph is the tool description the model sees.
- Write tool (`writes=True`): `fn` is a `WriteTool(prepare=..., apply=...)`:
  - `async def prepare(ctx, args) -> Proposal` builds a typed preview, writes NOTHING.
  - The registry raises `interrupt({"type": "confirm", "tool": name, "action": name, "preview": proposal.preview, "editable": proposal.editable})`.
  - Resume value: `{"decision": "accept"}` | `{"decision": "edit", "args": {...}}` (re-validated with ArgsModel and re-`prepare`d, then applied without a second confirm) | `{"decision": "cancel"}`.
  - Only on accept/edit: `async def apply(ctx, args, proposal) -> ToolResult`. Cancel returns a ToolResult telling the model the student declined; nothing is written.
  - You cannot register a write tool without going through this path (the registry rejects a bare coroutine with `writes=True`).
- `requires_flag`: a `feature_flags` key (app_config); the tool is not bound to the model, not listed, and rejected if called, unless the flag is on for this user (`FeatureFlag.on_for`). S15: `requires_flag="library"`; S15b: `"generation"`.

```python
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ToolContext:
    user_id: uuid.UUID          # the run's authenticated user (langgraph_auth_user), never from args or page context
    is_admin: bool
    run_id: str | None
    thread_id: str | None
    db: Database                # agent_db(); read as the user with `ctx.user_tx()` (RLS, role authenticated)
    exam_active: bool           # server-derived (active_exam); every tool refuses while True
    page: PageContext           # server-verified page context (question.answered re-checked against attempts)
    gateway: LLMGateway         # CallContext shared with the turn: tool LLM calls count toward the 4-call cap
    flags: dict[str, bool]
    def user_tx(self) -> AsyncContextManager[AsyncConnection]
    def attempted(self, question_ids) -> Awaitable[set[str]]   # S08 rule

@dataclass
class ToolResult:
    content: str                     # what the model reads; scrubbed again by llm.py; ≤ budgeted size (truncated to cited passages)
    blocks: list[dict] = []          # answer blocks ({type, data}) emitted as custom events and kept in state.blocks
    citations: list[dict] = []       # {id, title, url|target, source, layer, license?}
    canvas: list[CanvasRef] = []     # see canvas contract
    status: Literal["ok","error","declined","refused"] = "ok"
```
Rules every tool follows (review blockers): no `answer`, `answer_html`, `explanation_html`, `why_not_html`, `educational_objective` of an unattempted question, no vault content, no name/email in `content`, `blocks` or `citations`; read user data only via `ctx.user_tx()`; never log args or content. A leak-probe spy (`tools/model_eval/leak_probe.py`) runs every registered tool's output through the same check, so a new tool is covered automatically.

Registration lives in `naadi_api/agent/tools/__init__.py` (imports each tool module). S15: add `from . import knowledge_ingest  # noqa: F401` to it and own `tools/knowledge_ingest.py`; S15b: `tools/generation.py`. Tell me on the ledger; the one-line edit is yours to make.
